I often forget how bad the web is until I install a new browser or use some else's machine and I'm exposed to the unusable chum bucket that is the websites that John describes. This has increasingly pushed me towards RSS, reader mode, and text to voice to avoid these publishers web properties as much as I can. It's sad.
